hypothesis: Incremental historical against-flow effort quality with current Contender context unchanged
population: Same 124 previously analyzed DRF races; no sealed holdouts
history: Latest three prior rows matching target surface and distance; weights .5/.3/.2; do not replace malformed selected rows with older favorable rows
good_finish: Top three and within three lengths; winning lead margins never treated as beaten margins
early_against_flow: C/ý; both middle pre-stretch printed checkpoints position <=2 and within two lengths of leader; good finish
late_against_flow: S/ÿ; both middle pre-stretch printed checkpoints position >=4 and at least two lengths behind; good finish; gains >=2 positions and >=2 beaten lengths from third printed checkpoint to finish
call_labels: Five-slot standard rows only; use raw slots 2 and 3 without universal furlong labels
unknown_shapes: Unmarked/unknown flow is unknown, earns zero reward; not assumed neutral
surface_gate: Turf explicit ê/Ñ; dirt restricted to Aqu/BAQ/Sar/Bel/CD/Kee without synthetic/turf glyph; others withheld
adjustment: .05 times weighted sum of qualifying row indicators; no field percentile, no new setup interaction, no penalties, no fitting or threshold search
limitations: Reused exposed development results, not independent validation
Only historical flow-supported effort, not full effort quality
At most three matching rows, not general style classification
No Brisnet raw figures mixed with DRF
target_surface_consistency_gate: If frozen parent surface and parsed PP metadata disagree, withhold whole-field adjustment; preserve parent baseline and report discrepancy. Do not silently correct in this isolated test.
